products.name: Epic AI (SlicerDicer, etc.)
products.note: Clinical decision support; patient data exposure; HIPAA critical; FDA SaMD considerations

profile_text.body:
Epic Systems is a healthcare software company founded in 1979, originally based in a basement, that describes itself as developing software to help people get well, stay well, and help future generations be healthier. The company serves large health systems and medical centers across the United States with electronic health record and clinical software platforms.

On the AI side, Epic offers products grouped under its AI suite, including a feature called Insights, which generates AI-produced chart summaries to help clinicians review patient information more quickly. The company cites outcomes from several health system customers: clinicians at Mayo Clinic reported a 17% reduction in cognitive load, those at Riverside Health spent 23% less time reading notes, and those at Parkview Health spent 13% less time in Chart Review. Epic also offers Chart with Art, an AI charting tool for nursing documentation, which nurses at Mount Sinai Medical Center became the first in Florida to adopt. The site tracks Epic AI, which encompasses tools such as SlicerDicer, under the healthcare and life sciences AI category, with noted considerations around clinical decision support, patient data exposure, HIPAA compliance, and FDA software-as-a-medical-device classification.

No litigation, MCP server registrations, SEC filings, or patent records appear in the held data for Epic Systems.
